modeling_decisions: Concept has attractive slab relief but too many thin fern-like leaflets, invented central stalk, reconstructed basal disk and hand. Remove hand/stalk/disk; use broad tightly packed sigmoidal alternating units, nested shorter secondary furled ridges inside units, shallow negative integral relief. Axial slight bend indicates preservation only, not movement. Fossil no photographic grain. Slab thin with irregular corners; source Fig1F latex mould tonal polarity is not copied as exact fossil morphology. No equivalence between GB3D SM A48259 and paper LEIUG2328 asserted; BGS GSM105873 caption unambiguous.
